name: Machine Hip Abduction
steps: Sit with your back against the pad, feet on the rests and the pads against your outer thighs just above the knees.
Grip the side handles to stabilize your pelvis.
Press your knees outward against the pads by squeezing your outer glutes until your legs reach a full comfortable spread.
Control the pads slowly back together without letting the weight stack slam.
tips: Keep both feet in contact with the rests as you spread your knees.
Keep your torso steady instead of rocking forward and back with each repetition.
